headline.title: 20-year-old man arrested for allegedly throwing a Molotov cocktail at Sam Altman’s house
headline.summary: A 20-year-old man has been arrested by San Francisco police for allegedly throwing a Molotov cocktail at OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's house early Friday morning. The incident, which was captured on surveillance cameras, occurred shortly before 7 AM ET, and the suspect was later seen making threats outside OpenAI's premises.

articles.title: Anthropic temporarily banned OpenClaw’s creator from accessing Claude
articles.summary: Anthropic has temporarily banned the creator of OpenClaw from accessing its AI model, Claude, following a recent change in pricing for OpenClaw users. The decision comes in response to the adjustments made to Claude's pricing structure.

articles.title: Last 24 hours: Save up to $500 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
articles.summary: TechCrunch is offering a limited-time discount of up to $500 on passes for Disrupt 2026, with the promotion ending tonight at 11:59 p.m. PT. Interested attendees are encouraged to secure their passes before the deadline.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos Will Force a Cybersecurity Reckoning—Just Not the One You Think
articles.summary: Anthropic's new AI model, Mythos, is raising concerns among cybersecurity experts who warn it could be exploited by hackers. The model's introduction serves as a critical reminder for developers to prioritize security in their software design.

articles.title: The Iranian Lego AI video creators credit their virality to ‘heart’
articles.summary: Iranian content creation group Explosive Media has gained viral attention through AI-generated Lego videos that reinterpret recent geopolitical events, including the rescue of a downed airman. The creators attribute their success to the emotional resonance of their storytelling, which contrasts with mainstream narratives.

articles.title: Stalking victim sues OpenAI, claims ChatGPT fueled her abuser’s delusions and ignored her warnings
articles.summary: A stalking victim has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming that ChatGPT exacerbated her abuser's delusions and failed to respond to multiple warnings about his dangerous behavior. The lawsuit alleges that OpenAI ignored a mass-casualty flag and other alerts while the user continued to harass her.

articles.title: TechCrunch is heading to Tokyo — and bringing the Startup Battlefield with it
articles.summary: TechCrunch will host the Startup Battlefield at SusHi Tech 2026 in Tokyo, focusing on four key technology domains: AI, Robotics, Resilience, and Entertainment. The event will feature live demonstrations of humanoid robots, discussions on autonomous driving software, and explorations of AI's impact on the music and anime industries.

articles.title: National Robotics Week — Latest Physical AI Research, Breakthroughs and Resources
articles.summary: During National Robotics Week, NVIDIA showcases advancements in AI that are enhancing the capabilities of robots across various industries, including agriculture, manufacturing, and energy. Key developments in robot learning, simulation, and foundation models are facilitating the transition of robots from virtual training environments to real-world applications.

articles.title: Microsoft starts removing Copilot buttons from Windows 11 apps
articles.summary: Microsoft is removing the Copilot buttons from various Windows 11 apps, including Notepad and the Snipping Tool, in favor of alternative features like a "writing tools" menu. This change is part of an effort to streamline the user interface and eliminate what the company deems unnecessary elements.

articles.title: Gen Z’s love-hate relationship with AI
articles.summary: A recent Gallup report indicates that while Gen Z is becoming disillusioned with AI, they continue to use it in their daily lives. The study surveyed nearly 1,600 individuals aged 14 to 29 in the US, highlighting a growing ambivalence as AI becomes more integrated into education and the workplace.

articles.title: This Startup Wants You to Pay Up to Talk With AI Versions of Human Experts
articles.summary: Onix is introducing a platform that features AI-generated digital twins of health and wellness influencers, allowing users to pay for personalized advice around the clock. The service, described as the "Substack of bots," may also include product promotions from these virtual experts.

articles.title: Meta’s New AI Asked for My Raw Health Data—and Gave Me Terrible Advice
articles.summary: Meta's Muse Spark AI model provides health data analysis, including lab results, but raises significant privacy concerns and has been criticized for offering poor medical advice. Experts warn that it cannot replace professional medical guidance.
